title: Who writes a burned held-out case's replacement and its check while the cut is frozen
situation: Under 0103 a held-out case that failed in judgment is burned, and an illustrator writes its cold replacement. But a cut's held-out example text is frozen to everyone except the architect from the cut's opening until it is integrated, and its held-out checks freeze once seen to fail. So the illustrator cannot write the replacement, and its check-writer cannot bind it once the judgment folder is frozen. This was raised in the meaning-roles judgment.
decision: Recommended: the illustrator writes the replacement cold outside the cut's frozen paths. The architect, who alone changes the frozen examples, approves it and places it as the cut's held-out text. Its check-writer then binds it, and the freeze act freezes that check once it has been seen to fail (0125).
consequences: Accepted, a burned case is replaced without lifting the freeze for anyone but the architect. Replacing held-out agents 2 and 3 for the reply-discipline round follows it.
